title: Reliable community recipe launches and transparent runtime risk
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-7 makes large community-recipe launches recoverable and understandable, adds explicit vulnerability disclosure and moderator overrides, and broadens the constrained container contract to SGLang.
changes: Stream structured Docker layer and byte progress for recipe, app, and managed-engine image downloads, retry interrupted registry transfers within bounded limits, and preserve actionable failure details.
Report runtime-image packaging and cluster transfer progress instead of leaving large multi-Spark preparation phases indeterminate.
Recover interrupted advanced and managed container recipes through their correct lifecycle so daemon restarts do not rebind an already prepared image through the generic model path.
Explain post-weight startup work including engine initialization, TileLang and GPU-kernel compilation, KV-cache preparation, FlashInfer autotuning, DeepGEMM warmup, and final health verification.

Display retained HIGH and CRITICAL image findings in Discover and installed-recipe views, explain practical exposure in plain language, and require explicit acknowledgement before launching an affected recipe.

Add an audited moderator-only --force publication path for exact revisions whose fixable CRITICAL image findings were reviewed, without bypassing signatures, immutable inputs, scanner availability, manifest policy, or other validation failures.
Support constrained command-free SGLang community containers alongside vLLM and add validated memory and memory-swap ceilings for signed advanced containers.
Add pinned Ling 3.0 Flash SGLang and DeepSeek V4 Flash SparkInfer community recipe examples and improve structured CLI validation errors.
Complete Google, GitHub, and X sign-in through the current Spark's private Tailscale HTTPS address while retaining exact callback and active-device checks.
